policyNotes.intent: GitHub owns mergeability: required checks are strict against the current integration base and review threads must be resolved. Master remains a separate manual release.
policyNotes.approval: Native approval count stays at 0 while the repository has one human owner. Ordinary work still needs relevant GitHub review and an explicit or pre-recorded conditional merge mandate; master always needs a fresh production confirmation.
policyNotes.requiredChecks: This file lists GitHubs required checks. config/agent-workflow.json keeps the same locally owned check names; GitGuardian remains an external required check.
policyNotes.deletion: deletion and non_fast_forward must remain present so master cannot be deleted or force-pushed.
policyNotes.squash: allowed_merge_methods must include squash for normal preview delivery and promote paths. Other methods may remain for ancestry sync.
policyNotes.mutation: This file is a projection of the intended live ruleset; update the live ruleset and this file together.
